pages.text: Test a condition, running the action when true and the fallback when false. Either branch may be empty.

pages.title: Default Aether Cost
pages.text: Pay for the test and chosen branch. Reserve for the more expensive branch.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.1 + P + max(A,B) + 0.25*min(A,B), for condition P and branches A and B.
